# iru_blueprint_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a library item to an Iru Blueprint. This is an association resource: it manages one (blueprint, library item[, assignment node]) attachment. Any attribute change forces a new assignment.

**Map blueprint limitation:** the Iru API does not expose a map blueprint's node structure, so node IDs cannot be read back. If `assignment_node_id` is omitted, the item is placed on the map's default node; you can move it to a specific node in the Iru UI and it will not drift (Read only verifies the item is attached to the blueprint, not which node). Destroying/recreating the assignment resets it to the default node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a library item to a blueprint. For map blueprints with conditional
# logic, also set assignment_node_id.
resource "iru_blueprint_assignment" "core_wifi" {
  blueprint_id    = iru_blueprint.core.id
  library_item_id = iru_custom_profile.wifi.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) ID of the blueprint.
- `library_item_id` (String) ID of the library item to assign.

### Optional

- `assignment_node_id` (String) Assignment node ID. Required for map blueprints that use conditional logic; must be omitted for classic blueprints.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier `blueprint_id:library_item_id[:assignment_node_id]`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_blueprint_assignment.core_wifi
  identity = {
    blueprint_id    = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
    library_item_id = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) ID of the blueprint.
- `library_item_id` (String) ID of the assigned library item.

#### Optional

- `assignment_node_id` (String) Assignment node ID, for map blueprints.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_blueprint_assignment.core_wifi
  id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Assignments are imported as blueprint_id:library_item_id, plus :assignment_node_id for map blueprints.
terraform import iru_blueprint_assignment.core_wifi 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222
```
